content:
All sections
* Consider replacing "box" with "region".

Goal
* Please clarify that re(z) and im(z) denote the real and imaginary components of the complex number z, respectively.

* From points to characters: Consider replacing the first part ("The image has… grows upwards.") with the following:

The image representing the region has [[W]] columns and [[H]] rows.
The real part increases from left to right (columns 0 to [[W]] - 1), and the imaginary part increases from bottom to top (rows [[H]] - 1 to 0).
The diagram below shows the four corners of the image corresponding to the corners of the region:
```
         increasing imaginary
                   ^
                   |
(reMin, imMax)     |   (reMax, imMax)
       +----------------------+
       |                      |
       |                      | --> increasing real
       |                      |
       +----------------------+
(reMin, imMin)         (reMax, imMin)
```
The character at column [[col]] and row [[row]] represents the complex number c with the following components:
re(c) = [[reMin]] + [[col]] × ([[reMax]] - [[reMin]]) / ([[W]] - 1)
im(c) = [[imMax]] - [[row]] × ([[imMax]] - [[imMin]]) / ([[H]] - 1)

* Please replace "depend on rounding errors" with "are not affected by floating-point rounding errors" (or another more precise equivalent).

Input
* Line 2: Please replace "the box of the complex plane to draw" with "the lower and upper bounds of the real and imaginary parts of the region to draw."

Output
* Please format "H lines of W characters" in <<bold>>.

* Please remove "from top (imMax) to bottom (imMin)".

Constraints
* Please add "distinct" after "contains".

* Please change "without" to "excluding".

Tags
* Please add the tag "Complex Numbers".

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases where W < H. If possible, make
  - H close to its upper bound of 40,
  - reMin positive,
  - reMax close to its upper bound of 1.5, and
  - the palette length around 30.

Thanks.

I'll review your other puzzle within this week 😉

Hi! Zoom into any box of the Mandelbrot set and draw it in ASCII art, with characters chosen from each point's escape count.
Unlike the existing Mandelbrot puzzles (fixed view, single point), any area can be explored. All tests are checked against rounding errors.
Feedback on clarity and difficulty is welcome, thanks!

Thanks @5DN1L! All suggestions applied: "region", re/im definition, the corner diagram, input/output/constraints wording, and a new "Tall image" case (20×40, reMin > 0, reMax close to 1.5, 30-char palette).
PS: I'm experimenting with Claude to help write my statements. Feel free to tell me if it reads well or not!
Thanks! I don't have any further suggestions at the moment. And regarding Claude, I think the statement reads mostly clearly; that's why I haven't suggested many changes.
